business_description: JPMorgan Chase & Co. is a global financial services holding company and one of the largest U.S. banking institutions. The company provides consumer banking, credit cards, mortgage and auto lending, small-business banking, commercial banking, investment banking, markets, securities services, treasury services, asset management, and private banking. Its earnings are driven by net interest income from loans and securities funded by deposits and wholesale funding, fee income from payments and wealth management, and capital-markets revenue from underwriting, advisory, trading, and securities services.
business_model: Universal bank model combining a large U.S. deposit franchise, diversified consumer and commercial lending, global investment banking and markets operations, payments and treasury services, and asset/wealth management. The model benefits from scale, brand, technology investment, risk management, and cross-selling across households, corporates, institutions, and high-net-worth clients. Profitability is sensitive to net interest margin, loan growth, deposit costs, credit losses, capital requirements, market activity, and expense efficiency.
